title: Liquor approved manager licence
summary: This page provides information about the requirements and processes for obtaining a liquor approved manager licence.
who_can_apply: Must be an individual responsible for managing a liquor licence and ensuring compliance with liquor laws.
what_you_need: Information on the requirements and processes for obtaining the licence.

internal_links.text: Apply for a liquor approved manager licence

faqs.q: What is a liquor approved manager licence?
faqs.a: A liquor approved manager licence is required for individuals who manage a liquor licence and are responsible for ensuring compliance with liquor laws.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a liquor approved manager licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a liquor approved manager licence using the dedicated online transaction.

faqs.q: What if I need to appoint a liquor approved manager?
faqs.a: If you need to appoint a liquor approved manager for your premises, you can use the online appointment service.
